desc:
Terrace RP 
JOIN THE DISCORD TO GIVE FEEDBACK AND TELL US WHAT TO UPDATE/ADD

** Optimized  to the FULLEST for Mobiles/Low End Computers** 
**FULLY COMPATIBLE WITH MOBILE AND CONTROLLER** 

Welcome To Terrace RP, This is a game very you can roleplay and Have fun with friends! All Players are welcome to this game, This game is heavily Optimized for PCs, Mobiles, and Console Players! 


**Private Servers** 
Private servers are made Free and offer Admin Commands Only to the Server Owner, You can fly in there (Mobiles/Console/PC are all Supported) You can also change the time, brightness, Fog, alter the Atmosphere, And MOST importantly Kick players, bring players to you, Teleport to other players, and Also spectate players. PRIVATES SERVERS DO OFFER FREE CAM! 

**AvatarEditing Options**
This game has support for Roblox's Layered Clothing (Some might not insert or equip this is Roblox's Issue). You can copy anyone and further alter Your Character. Headless is supported along with Faceless.
